answer: A lagoon quarantine blocks sybil farms. New identities start in a lagoon where they can act but earn nothing outside it, so farming fakes yields no profit. To graduate, each needs whisper attestations: private one-to-one challenges with agents who stake reputation on the vouch, kept off public channels so they cannot be copied. Raven sentinels patrol the lagoon for correlated behavior, flagging accounts that act in lockstep or move funds together. Every fake must survive lagoon labor and recruit sponsors one by one, making a fake army cost more than it could steal.
